fields.description: About Neo4j: Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems. It includes enterprise-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy-to-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world’s largest graph community. Intelligence that works. Results that matter. Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business. Our Vision: At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data. As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive. Director, GraphAware Engineering The role We are looking for a Director of Engineering to lead Hume engineering: about 25 engineers in five product-aligned teams, plus the DevOps team, working across Europe. Hume is a graph-powered intelligence analysis platform. Analysts in law enforcement, customs, financial crime and national security use it to find the connections that matter in their cases. You will report to the Senior Director for GraphAware Products, who leads both product and engineering. You will work as a peer of the Director of Product Management. You have two core responsibilities, and they matter equally. The first is the people: grow the engineering team in size, skills and knowledge, by hiring well and by coaching engineers into stronger engineers, tech leads and future leaders. The second is the system that lets those teams decide autonomously and deliver well: clear team ownership, sound decisions, predictable releases, secure practices and effective AI-assisted development. The two reinforce each other: a good system helps people grow faster, and people who grow keep improving the system. Engineering should not depend on a few individuals to resolve every architecture, release or staffing question, and that includes you. This is a leadership role. You will not write production code day to day. You need enough technical depth to earn senior engineers' respect, ask the right questions in a design review and diagnose a production incident. Then you hand the decision back to the people who own it. What you will own Teams and people. Lead, coach and grow the team leads and tech leads. Build management and senior technical career paths, hiring within the team, and plan succession so no area depends on one person. Delivery. Own engineering's organisation-wide commitments. Put in place planning, checkpoints and tracking that the teams run themselves, so risks and dependencies surface early. Release quality. Treat everything we ship as the product: installation packages, Helm charts, Docker Compose, configuration and documentation, tested on every deployment environment we support, including on-premises and restricted environments. Own the definition of done, code-review discipline and vulnerability mitigation within agreed targets. Secure engineering. Work with our Security & Compliance colleagues, who run the ISO 27001 programme, and make sure engineering practice meets it. Technical ownership. Be accountable for Hume's overall technical excellence: architecture, code quality, performance and security. Challenge and shape the major technical decisions together with the tech leads, and set how decisions are made, challenged and recorded. Delegate design to tech leads and principal engineers, and evolve the architecture so most changes need only one team. Set clear guidance on where AI-assisted development helps and where it doesn't. DevOps. Lead the DevOps team and own its priorities, balancing the teams' requests against platform improvements. How you will work You care about the problem we solve. Product owns what we build and why; engineering owns how and whether it is feasible. You care about the why as well. You understand how an investigation runs and what an analyst needs, and you join customer conversations to hear it first-hand. You bring trade-offs and alternatives to the Director of Product Management early, before commitments are made, so product and engineering plan as one. You are part of the Science & Technology team, as well as engineering's leader. You bring engineering's view into its decisions early and openly, and you challenge them, including your manager's. Once a decision is made, you own it with your teams and explain the reasoning behind it. You build trust in both directions: engineers know their view is heard, and the leadership team can rely on engineering's commitments. You communicate clearly, in writing first. You write updates people can act on, and decisions are recorded where everyone can read them. You explain difficult decisions plainly to engineers, to Neo4j colleagues and to customers. You bring decisions, not only questions. You own engineering's response to customers and the field. In practice that means three things. Customer escalations and production issues get a named owner, a response and follow-through to the fix. Deployment and support questions from field engineers and customers are answered within agreed targets. And the release dates and scope the field shares with customers are ones engineering has committed to, agreed with the product team. You are the escalation point when something is stuck. What you need to bring Experience leading an engineering organisation of about 20 or more people across several teams, through tech leads or engineering managers, accountable for both delivery and people. A strong background as a senior engineer and tech lead in backend, data or platform systems. You can review architecture across a JVM backend, a modern web front end, AI/LLM components and CI/CD. Experience reorganising engineering teams around product domains, using Team Topologies, strategic Domain-Driven Design or similar, and bringing people with you through the change. A track record of improving delivery, quality and release practices for a complex product that customers deploy themselves. Clear written and spoken communication in English, and experience leading distributed teams across countries. Nice to have Graph databases (especially Neo4j), knowledge graphs or GraphRAG. Building LLM-based or data-intensive products in production, and leading teams through adopting AI-assisted development. Products for law enforcement, government or other security-sensitive customers. Leading engineering through an acquisition or integration into a larger company. What this role is not Not the sole architect or a full-time coder: design belongs to the tech leads, and you make sure it is challenged and written down. Not the product owner: you shape what we build through partnership with the Director of Product Management, not by deciding it. Location Based in Italy, Czechia, Spain, the Netherlands or the UK, working remotely with teams across Europe. Occasional travel for team gatherings, Neo4j and customers. Italy only: The gross annual salary (RAL) range for this role when based in Italy is €90.000-€110.000. Salary is set individually for each candidate, based on objective, gender-neutral criteria such as experience, skills and scope of responsibility. Contract under the collective bargaining agreement (CCNL Metalmeccanici Industria). This information applies to Italy only. For other countries, please speak with the recruiter. Why Join Neo4j? Neo4j is, without question, the most popular graph intelligence platform in the world. We have customers in every industry globally, and our products are a proven product/market fit. Joining our team is an opportunity to shape the future of data and analytics. Below are just a few exciting facts about Neo4j. Neo4j is one of the fastest-scaling technology companies in this industry. It recently surpassed $200M in annual recurring revenue (ARR), doubling its ARR over the past three years. Raised the biggest funding round in database history ($325M Series F). Backed by world-class investors like Eurazeo, GV (formerly Google Ventures), and Inovia Capital, Neo4j has raised over $600M in funding and is currently valued at over $2Bn. This puts Neo4j among the most well-funded database companies in history. 84% of the Fortune 100 and 58% of the Fortune 500 use Neo4j. Examples include Boston Scientific , BT Group , Caterpillar , Cisco , Comcast , Department for Education UK , eBay , NBC News , Novo Nordisk , Worldline , and others . Co-founder and CEO Emil Eifrem has built an amazing culture that prides itself on relationships, inclusiveness, innovation, and customer success. Countless industry awards . Massive enterprises and individual developers/data scientists love Neo4j. A strong sense of community and ecosystem is built around the platform. A recent Forrester Total Economic Impact™ Study cited Neo4j as delivering 417% ROI to customers. Research shows that members of underrepresented communities are less likely to apply for jobs when they don’t meet all the qualifications. If this is part of the reason you hesitate to apply, we’d encourage you to reconsider and give us the opportunity to review your application. At Neo4j, we are committed to building awareness and helping to improve these issues. One of our central objectives is to provide an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace for everyone to develop their potential and have a positive, career-defining experience. We look forward to receiving your application. Neo4j Values: Neo4j is a Silicon Valley company with a Swedish soul. We foster collaboration and each of us is empowered to contribute and put our innovative stamp on projects.
